name: sim_checkpoint_roundtrip_busy
description: A busy three-seat match (a caretaker from tick 0, AWAY, BACK and LEFT, contested cells, a sale, signals, Ready presses and refused orders) replayed into a simulation replaced by deserialize(serialize()) every 7 ticks, and every 61 with events on: every tick's hash equals the uninterrupted run's. Every record's field takes a non-default value somewhere in this match, so a codec that drops one is caught (review M1 determinism 2; sim_checkpoint_roundtrip checks one moment).

steps.msg: the busy match ran to its end through several waves
a seat was away and back, one left, and the caretaker worked its plan
a tower was sold and signals were sent

steps.assert: every7['first_bad'] == -1 and every7['final'] == rec['final_tick'] and every7['trips'] > 1000
steps.msg: a round trip every 7 ticks keeps every tick's hash
and every 61 ticks with events on
